description: This file defines the CatalogItem entity class, which represents a catalog item in the application. It includes properties such as Name, Description, Price, PictureUri, and associated CatalogType and CatalogBrand. The class provides methods for updating its details, brand, type, and picture URI, and includes a nested record struct for encapsulating catalog item details.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Entity class representing a catalog item with properties and methods for managing item details and associations.

methods.name: CatalogItem
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new catalog item with specified parameters.

methods.name: UpdateDetails
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's name, description, and price with validation.

methods.name: UpdateBrand
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's brand ID with validation.

methods.name: UpdateType
methods.description: Updates the catalog item's type ID with validation.

methods.name: UpdatePictureUri
methods.description: Sets the picture URI for the catalog item, optionally clearing it.
